subject: DPA scope, SCCs and transfer-routing exception request — HelixOps
messages:
From: Sally Park <sally.park@helixops.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Liu <daniel.liu@helixops.com>; legal@helixops.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: DPA: SCCs and routing exceptions — HelixOps

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the productive demo last week. Our legal/procurement teams are working through the contract and flagged two items that need alignment before procurement will sign: the Data Processing Addendum (DPA) redlines and an exception request for our limited routing requirement (HelixOps requires that EU personal data be routed and processed only in the EU unless specific fallbacks are used).

High level asks:
- Can Redwood accept the new SCCs language we attached and confirm the permitted routing fallback (i.e. Azure West EU and GCP Frankfurt only)?
- If Redwood cannot accept the exact language, what alternative protective measures (e.g., encrypted transit + processor-only republication restrictions + evidence logs) can you commit to?
- Procurement asked for an annex describing the transfer-impact mitigation we can provide (evidence cadence, audit protocol, KMS locality).

I've attached our redline and a short appendix showing the routing expectation. Procurement has a hard deadline of 2027-04-22 for signed order forms if possible.

Can we get a written response and a 30-minute legal sync this week?

Thanks,
Sally Park
General Counsel (Contracts)
HelixOps
Attachments: helixops_dpa_redline.docx, helixops_transfer_appendix.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sally Park <sally.park@helixops.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA: SCCs and routing exceptions — HelixOps

Hi Sally — thanks for the note and the materials. Looping in Ben (privacy & contracts) and Karthik (security engineering) so we can put a response together.

Quick plan:
1) Ben/Karthik will review your redline and routing appendix and propose a compromise DPA clause set + a short transfer-impact annex that describes technical and operational mitigations.
2) We can do a 30-minute legal sync on Wed 2027-04-14 09:00–09:30 PT / 18:00–18:30 CET — does that work for your team?
3) If we can align on clause text by Thursday 2027-04-15, procurement has time to sign by your 4/22 target.

We understand the routing ask is important — our usual approach is to support region pinning and provide cross-border fallback only under documented, audited circumstances. We'll propose language that preserves your controls while keeping our production resilience.

Thanks — talk soon.
Mina Haddad
Manager, Customer Success (Enterprise)
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0190

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: DPA: SCCs and routing exceptions — proposed language

Mina / Karthik — I reviewed HelixOps' redline and drafted a candidate compromise. Key points in our suggested approach (attached as redwood_suggested_dpa_clauses.pdf):

- SCCs: We agree to incorporate the EU SCCs (2021) into the DPA, but propose a short addendum that explicitly allows processor fallback when (1) operator capacity constraint would otherwise cause service outage, or (2) a specific security incident requires cross-region processing. Fall back will be limited to certified regions (Azure West EU, GCP Frankfurt).

- Transfer-impact annex: We propose to provide an annex that documents: KMS key locality (EUC-1), periodic evidence exports (quarterly logs of processed PII by region), and SOC2 + supplemental audit clauses. The annex will include a checklist of evidence items to be produced on request (see sccs_exception_rationale.docx).

- Compensating controls: In addition to the annex, we will commit to: encrypted-in-transit, encrypted-at-rest with customer-managed keys option for Dedicated customers, and a 72-hour notification SLA for cross-border processing events.

Next steps:
- I attached the redwood_suggested_dpa_clauses.pdf and sccs_exception_rationale.docx for legal review.
- If HelixOps can accept the annex language, we can integrate it into the order form as an exhibit and push to signatures.

I recommend Mina coordinate the Wed sync — I'll join and Karthik can speak to the KMS locality tradeoffs.

Ben
Senior Manager, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_suggested_dpa_clauses.pdf, sccs_exception_rationale.docx

From: Sally Park <sally.park@helixops.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Liu <daniel.liu@helixops.com>; legal@helixops.com
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA: SCCs and routing exceptions — HelixOps redline & next steps

Thanks Ben — appreciate the clear options. We reviewed your annex and have a couple of small but material asks:

1) Procurement confirmed they can accept the fallback conditions but want the 72-hour notification SLA tightened to 24 hours and a short penalty clause if our org-level data residency obligations are violated (we included suggested language in our redline).
2) KMS locality: we need confirmation that the customer-managed key option is usable for the Hosted API mode (not only Dedicated).

I've attached our version of the redline (helixops_dpa_redline.docx) with specific edits and a proposed order-form exhibit. Procurement is ready to sign but needs the final DPA annex and the order form updated. I've also uploaded the signed order form draft to DocuSign; link below. Can Redwood confirm the KMS behavior and whether the 24-hour notification and small penalty language are acceptable?

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ABC123-HelixOps-OrderForm
Attachment: helixops_dpa_redline.docx

Sally Park
General Counsel
HelixOps

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sally Park <sally.park@helixops.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA: SCCs and routing exceptions — next steps and confirmation

Sally — thanks, and good notes. Quick confirmations and plan:

- KMS customer-managed keys on Hosted API: Karthik confirms we can support CMKs for Hosted customers under a new configuration profile (we'll need a short technical onboarding step; details in the annex). We'll include explicit wording that CMK availability for Hosted mode is provided within 30 days of contract execution.
- Notification SLA: we're willing to move to a 24-hour notification for cross-border processing events. Regarding the penalty, we can accept a capped remedy tied to order form value (we'll run legal to produce the exact cap language and redline).

Action items:
- Ben to convert the annex and penalty cap language into final redlines and produce a single merged doc by Thu 2027-04-22 EOD.
- Mina to schedule an exec-level procurement handshake call for 2027-04-21 (15:00 CET) to clear signatures if redlines are accepted.
- Karthik to prepare a short technical appendix on CMK configuration and onboarding (deliverable: technical appendix PDF).

If HelixOps can accept those deliverables, we should be able to complete signatures before your 4/22 procurement deadline. Thanks everyone — moving to action.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Manager, Customer Success (Enterprise)
Redwood Inference
